_comment: Wireless firmware the image ships for cards the tree can drive but has no
firmware for. prebuilt_firmware.py fetches each file into /dlcache, checks
the sha256, and stages it under vendor/jetson-tv/Firmware. Nothing binary
is committed to this repo, the same arrangement as PrebuiltApps.
Pinned to a linux-firmware tag, not to main: the kernel here is 4.9, whose
iwlwifi accepts 8265 ucode API 22 to 26 and asks for those filenames
exactly. main carries only 34 and 36 now, which this driver would never
ask for. Do not 'update' these to newer files without first checking
These are Intel's binaries, redistributable under the licence shipped with
them; they are firmware, not software linked into anything, so no source

files.name: iwlwifi-8265-22.ucode
files.why: Wi-Fi for Intel Wireless-AC 8260/8265 (8265NGW), driven by iwlmvm.

files.name: ibt-12-16.sfi
files.why: Bluetooth for the same card: its BT half is a USB device, btusb/btintel.
